title: MCSuite
description: Everything you will ever need for your Minecraft SMP.
body:
# MCSuite - The Suite for Minecraft SMP's
MCSuite is one plugin combining all features your Minecraft Server needs.
Our Plugin tries to get rid of tens of plugins each doing microservices, oftentimes interfering with eachother. We bring tons of features, but if you dont like some of them, you can easily disable them!

## Features:
- Homes 🏠️
  - Configurable Home Limits
- TPA 🌀
  - Configurable Teleport Countdown
- Nicknames 📄
  - Colored Nicknames (Permissions can be configured)
  - Real Name Hints (On hover)
- Combat Timer ⏳️
- Ban Durations 🔨
- Trading 🪎
  - Advanced GUI system
- Chunk Claiming 🗺️
  - In-GUI Map
  - Change what players can do in your Chunks
- Econonmy 💱
  - Vault-Compatible
  - Online-Money and Physical Cash (For Trading)
- Scoreboard & Actionbar Customisation 📑
	- Supports PlaceholderAPI
- Maintenance Mode 🚧
	- Enable Maintenance mode with a Timer, and it will announce in Chat in how much time the server will go into maintenance. During maintenance, only players with permission can join the server.
	- You can also set a Duration for maintenance
- Resource Pack Merging 📦️
  - Put all of the Resourcepacks you want in your server in a directory, it will merge and apply them to the server automatically!
- Extreme Configuration 📜
  - Toggle every single Feature by itself
  - Every number can be Configured
